title: Mep Engineer
description:
Responsible for coordinating, monitoring and supervising Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) services for large-scale IT park/commercial building projects, ensuring that all MEP works are executed safely, on schedule, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, project standards and quality requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. MEP Coordination Coordinate HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and ELV services with civil, structural, architectural and interior works. Review MEP layouts, GFC/shop drawings, specifications and BOQs before execution. Identify and resolve service clashes and interface issues to minimize rework. Coordinate service routing, ceiling spaces, shafts, plant rooms and equipment areas. Conduct regular coordination meetings with contractors, subcontractors, consultants and project teams. 2. Site Execution & Supervision Monitor day-to-day MEP installation activities and ensure execution as per approved drawings and specifications. Supervise HVAC, ducting, piping, electrical containment, cabling, plumbing, drainage, firefighting and related MEP works. Check workmanship, installation quality, levels, alignment, supports and accessibility for maintenance. Identify site constraints and provide practical engineering solutions. 3. Drawing & Technical Coordination Review and coordinate GFC, shop drawings, builders-work drawings and as-built drawings. Check technical submittals, material approvals, method statements and installation procedures. Raise and follow up RFIs/TQs for design clarifications. Coordinate revisions arising from site conditions and client/consultant comments. Ensure the latest approved drawings are available at site. 4. HVAC Coordination Coordinate AHU, FCU, VRF/VRV, ventilation and exhaust systems. Coordinate ductwork, chilled-water/refrigerant piping, insulation, supports and equipment installation. Verify equipment locations, service clearances and maintenance access. Coordinate HVAC works with electrical, fire-fighting, plumbing, ceiling and architectural requirements. 5. Electrical & ELV Coordination Coordinate cable trays, trunking, conduits, busducts and electrical equipment. Coordinate electrical power, lighting, DBs, panels, UPS and related systems. Interface with ELV systems such as fire alarm, CCTV, access control, BMS, data/ICT and other building systems as applicable. Ensure proper coordination between electrical services and other MEP systems. 6. Plumbing & Fire Protection Coordination Coordinate domestic water supply, drainage, sanitary, rainwater and related plumbing services. Coordinate fire-fighting piping, pumps, hydrants, sprinklers and associated services. Ensure proper routing, slopes, supports, access and maintenance clearances. 7. Quality Control & Inspection Conduct regular inspections of MEP installations. Verify materials against approved specifications and material submittals. Prepare/coordinate inspection requests and obtain consultant/client approvals. Identify defects and ensure timely rectification. Maintain inspection records, checklists and snag lists. 8. Testing & Commissioning Coordinate testing and commissioning of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and ELV systems. Witness and document testing activities as required. Coordinate TAB activities for HVAC systems where applicable. Ensure all commissioning records and test certificates are properly maintained. Support final snagging, system demonstrations and project handover. 9. Progress & Contractor Management Monitor daily and weekly MEP progress against the project programme. Coordinate manpower, materials, equipment and work fronts with subcontractors. Follow up material deliveries and ensure materials are properly stored. Monitor subcontractor productivity and workmanship. Highlight delays, constraints and potential programme impacts to the Project Manager. 10. Safety Ensure MEP activities comply with project HSE requirements. Coordinate safe working practices, permits, work-at-height requirements and PPE compliance. Participate in toolbox meetings and site safety inspections. Ensure proper housekeeping and safe storage of MEP materials. 11. Documentation & Reporting Prepare daily/weekly MEP progress reports. Maintain drawing registers, RFI/TQ registers, inspection records and material approval status. Maintain snag lists and monitor closure. Coordinate preparation and submission of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, test reports and commissioning documents. Assist in monthly progress measurement and contractor billing verification where required. Required Skills & Experience Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical or related Engineering discipline. Relevant experience in large-scale commercial/IT park projects preferred. Good knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and ELV coordination. Ability to read and interpret MEP drawings and specifications. Knowledge of AutoCAD; Revit/Navisworks knowledge is an advantage. Good understanding of site execution, testing and commissioning. Strong coordination and communication skills. Ability to coordinate multiple subcontractors and disciplines simultaneously. Good knowledge of quality and safety requirements. Preferred Project Experience Experience in the following types of projects will be an advantage: IT Parks / Data Centres Commercial Buildings SEZ Projects High-rise Buildings Office Campuses Industrial Buildings Large-scale HVAC and MEP projects Key Performance Areas (KPIs) MEP work completed as per project schedule Reduction of service clashes and rework Quality of MEP installation Timely closure of inspections and RFIs Contractor/subcontractor coordination Testing & commissioning completion Snag-free handover Safety compliance Accuracy and timely submission of MEP documentation Benefits: Cell phone reimbursement Paid time off Petrol allowan ce

title: Functional Domain consultant - Life science
description:
Job Description Functional Domain Consultant – Life Sciences As a Functional Order management Domain Consultant – Life Sciences, you will play a key role in supporting, optimizing, and transforming Order management business processes across the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, and healthcare sectors. You will work closely with business stakeholders, quality teams, supply chain functions, manufacturing operations, regulatory affairs, and digital transformation teams to improve operational efficiency, compliance, and business outcomes. The role requires strong Life Sciences domain expertise, process improvement capabilities, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable business and technology solutions. You will contribute to regulatory compliance, process standardization, operational excellence, and enterprise transformation initiatives across the Life Sciences value chain. Key Responsibilities Act as the functional domain expert for Life Sciences Order Management business processes and operations. Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimization, standardization, automation, and compliance improvements. Support execution of process improvement and transformation initiatives, focusing on efficiency, cost optimization, and service quality improvement. Contribute to the successful delivery of transformation projects in the Order Management and Fulfilment domain. Facilitate business process mapping, requirements gathering, solution design, developing target operating models (TOM) and process improvement workshops. Work closely with cross-functional teams to support end-to-end business process integration. Collaborate with business stakeholders across Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Commercial functions. Support issue resolution and process troubleshooting impacting business operations and regulatory compliance. Monitor operational and compliance KPIs and recommend actions to improve efficiency, quality, and performance. Participate in testing, validation, user acceptance testing (UAT), and business readiness activities. Develop and maintain process documentation, SOPs, work instructions, and training materials. Support data governance, process governance, and continuous improvement initiatives. Contribute to digital transformation programs including automation, analytics, and compliance modernization initiatives. Key Skills Analytical & Problem Solving Strong analytical capabilities to assess business challenges and identify process improvement opportunities. Ability to perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). Strong troubleshooting skills in regulated business environments. Ability to analyze operational, quality, and compliance data to support decision-making. Strong attention to detail with a quality and compliance-focused mindset. Ability to balance business objectives with regulatory and compliance requirements. Domain Skills Strong knowledge of Order Management, Fulfilment, and Logistics processes within end-to-end Supply Chain operations. Strong understanding of Life Sciences industry processes and operations. Knowledge of: Pharmaceutical Operations Biotechnology Business Processes Medical Device Operations Clinical Trial Processes Regulatory Affairs Quality Management Systems (QMS) Validation and Compliance Processes Supply Chain & Distribution in Life Sciences Understanding of regulatory frameworks and standards in Life Sciences industry. Knowledge of traceability, serialization, batch management, and product quality processes. Experience with ERP-enabled Life Sciences business processes is preferred. Professional Skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with global and cross-functional teams. Strong consulting, facilitation, and business partnering capabilities. Ability to influence stakeholders and drive processes change initiatives. Strong ownership, accountability, and problem-solving attitude. Effective presentation, documentation, and training skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a highly regulated and fast-paced environment. Strong organizational and project coordination skills. Qualification/ Our Ideal Candidate 8-10 years of experience of order management process in Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, Healthcare Operations, or related domains. Experience supporting business operations, process transformation, quality, compliance, or digital initiatives within Life Sciences organizations. Strong understanding of Life Sciences processes, regulatory requirements, and quality standards. Experience participating in business transformation, ERP implementation, quality system implementation, or digital modernization programs. Understanding of quality management, compliance management, risk management, and supply chain processes. Knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing, commercial operations, clinical operations, or regulatory processes is highly preferred. Educational Qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in supply chain management, Life science, Medtech, Healthcare, Operations, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline. Preferred Certifications: Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt PMP / Prince2 Lean Process Improvement Certifications Preferred Experience in: Pharmaceutical Operations Biotechnology Industry Processes Medical Device Manufacturing Life Sciences Supply Chain Digital Transformation and Regulatory Compliance Programs Global Life Sciences Operations and Transformation Initiatives

title: Senior Engineer Indirect Purchase
description:
Job Summary: Are you ready to take your engineering career to the next level? Emerson is seeking a highly motivated Senior Purchase Engineer to join the team in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. As a Purchase Professional, you will exhibit a strong work ethic and demonstrate exceptional proficiency in ensuring detailed and efficient procurement processes, enabling us to challenge in the global market. 
 In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Research and identify suitable suppliers to meet the part specification needs. Evaluate supplier performance based on quality, cost, and delivery reliability. Compare quotes from multiple suppliers to ensure pricing and negotiate at each stage like Item activation and project base order before fixing the sourcing rule. Collaborate with internal teams to understand purchasing requirements. Forecast demand for goods to fix effective procurement plans. Maintain accurate records of purchases, contracts, and supplier communications. Ensure compliance with company quality policies, legal regulations, and industry standards. Procurement of stores through Indigenous and foreign sources as required in accordance with the rules in force. Checking of requisitions/purchase indents. Selection of suppliers for issue of enquiries. Issuing enquiries/tenders and obtaining quotations. Analyzing quotations and bids etc, and preparation of comparative statement Collate purchase orders and purchase requisitions in order-to-order materials, goods and supplies. Review Excess inventories and order as required. Interact with the suppliers on a day-to-day basis and Review deliveries against the orders. Track the status of all open orders and Follow-up of purchase orders for delivery in due time. Verification and passing of suppliers bills to see that payments are made promptly. Ensuring all invoices are sent to accounts for payment process after good receipt. Resolve issues such as delays, defective products, or incorrect shipments. Maintenance of purchase records and vendor performance records/data. Ensure accuracy and timely Attribute study and setting in Oracle system. Effective co-ordination with Global Supply Chain (GSC) team across the world and align to their vendor management policies and consistent vendor performance. Align materials as per Oracle Demand date, synchronized receipt of materials & in turn support in meeting customer delivery dates. To review and set purchase policies on requirements of material from time to time and develop and maintain good buyer-seller (Vendor) relationship. Loading the foundry based on the RCCP tonnage allocated to each foundry as per GSC Guidelines. Analysis on Loading pattern based on Supplier performance of each vendor and surge loading of vendor based upon the project order flow in previous month. Submitting all transporter bills on time to Payable team and Tracking all transport payment, the NSDJ progress which is created to stock transfer of D-excess parts. Maintaining all Purchase metrics data - OTD, PPM and spent analysis report. Identifying the D-excess parts and allocating them to the current demand with approval from QC. Review and clearance of Vendor invoices for on time payment processing. 
 Who We Are: You act with a clear sense of ownership, build and deliver solutions that meet customer expectations, establish and maintain effective customer relationships and credit others for their contributions and accomplishments. 
 For This Role, You Will Need: Degree or equivalent experience or experience in Engineering and 5+ years Material Planning & Purchasing experience. Implementing an improved efficient sourcing strategy to avoid the lead time and other indirect cost. Well versed in MPS (Master Production Scheduling) and MRP (Material Requirement Planning). Candidate dedicated on achieving outcomes. Ability to travel across India and other world area on situation arise.

title: Power System Testing & Commissioning Engineer
company: Technical Institute Of Science And Engineering Consultant
description:
Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and technically skilled Testing and Commissioning (T&C) Engineer specializing in electrical power systems, substations, switchgear, and protection schemes. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading site testing activities, conducting pre-commissioning and commissioning checks on primary and secondary power equipment, ensuring adherence to safety codes, and handover of assets to clients in compliance with international standards (IEC, IEEE) and utility guidelines. Key Responsibilities & Core Competencies Site Execution & Planning: Plan, schedule, and execute comprehensive testing and commissioning activities for high-voltage (HV), medium-voltage (MV), and low-voltage (LV) electrical installations. Primary Equipment Testing: Perform routine and advanced factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) for primary equipment including Power Transformers, GIS/AIS Switchgear, Circuit Breakers, Current/Voltage Transformers (CT/VT), and Isolators. Protection & Control Testing: Conduct secondary injection testing, differential/overcurrent protection relay configuration and testing (ABB, Siemens, GE, SEL), metering verification, and interlock checks. Advanced Diagnostics: Execute specialized electrical measurements including Insulation Resistance (Megger), Polarization Index (PI), Winding Resistance, Tan Delta, Partial Discharge, Contact Resistance, and Earthing/Grounding resistance measurements. Wiring & SCADA Verification: Verify control and schematic wiring, perform loop checks, functional checks of SCADA/RTU integration, DC battery charger and UPS testing. Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot and diagnose complex electrical system faults, wiring discrepancies, or hardware failures during commissioning phases. Documentation & Handover: Prepare clear, precise T&C procedures, Method Statements, risk assessments (HSE), inspection checklists, and comprehensive final testing reports for client and utility approvals. Qualifications & Requirements Education: Bachelors Degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) or equivalent technical degree. Experience: 3 to 6 years of proven professional experience in testing and commissioning of electrical substations, power plants, or heavy industrial networks. Test Equipment Proficiency: Hands-on experience with advanced testing instruments (e.g., Omicron CPC100, CMC 356, Megger, Doble test sets). Standards & Compliance: In-depth knowledge of international standards (IEC, IEEE, BS, NETA) and local utility regulations. Technical Know-How: Strong understanding of electrical protection schemes, single-line diagrams (SLDs), schematic drawings, and wiring diagrams. Soft Skills & Safety: Outstanding communication skills, ability to lead on-site sub-contractors, and strict commitment to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards. Preferred Qualifications Valid international or local utility approvals / certifications (e.g., DEWA, SEC, Kahramaa, or equivalent). Certification in relay configuration and advanced power testing (e.g., Omicron or Doble certified engineer). First Aid and high-voltage safety certifications.

Key Skills: Testing and Commissioning,Commissioning,Power system,Software testing,System,System testing,Compensation,Commissioning

title: Senior SAP ABAP & Fiori Technical Consultant - S/4HANA & BTP
description:
Design, build, and support SAP ABAP and Fiori enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and applications aligned to business requirements. Role Overview A technical role delivered under a strict clean-core mandate. The program has deliberately constrained its build: 79% of requirements are met by standard configuration, and the WRICEF objects will be gated behind conditions precedent - a validated requirement, a quantified benefit, and confirmation that no standard alternative exists - and extensions are delivered on SAP BTP rather than by modifying the core. This role needs judgment as well as skill: the largest technical risk on the program is over-customization, specifically rebuilding a legacy shop-floor system''s bespoke lot-numbering and lot-handling logic one-for-one inside SAP. You will be expected to resist that. Key Responsibilities Translate functional specifications from all workstreams into technical designs, honest estimates and clean-core-compliant build approaches; challenge designs better solved by configuration.Develop the report backlog using CDS views, RAP services and analytical Fiori applications in preference to classical ABAP list reports.Develop enhancements using released extension points - BAdIs, key-user and developer extensibility - rather than core modifications or implicit enhancements.Design and build interfaces between S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation and edge systems and the analytics layer, using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) plus IDoc, OData, REST and file patterns.Build custom and extended Fiori applications with SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English language support.Build the traveler / batch-card print program and forms carrying resolved machine, tool, hardness, mold, cavity and lot detail; implement quality, hold and disposition approval workflows; build the flexible master-data maintenance application if it clears its gate.Build the composite KPI CDS layer and the post-Material-Ledger allocation engine in the agreed architecture; enforce clean-core governance - extension registry, released-API discipline, upgrade-safety review, code review - and document objects so client IT can maintain them. BATCH MANAGEMENT TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE - REQUIRED Hands-on Batch Management and end-to-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch, lot and cavity-level traceability sits at the center of this program; candidates without demonstrable hands-on experience in the following will not be shortlisted:Batch and classification data structures in S/4HANA - batch master, characteristics and classification, batch determination and status - and how to read, extend and report on them without breaking standard behavior.Batch number assignment: standard internal/external number ranges, the batch number BAdI, and the judgment to say honestly when a bespoke lot-number format genuinely cannot be met by standard next-number maintenance. Replicating legacy lot-numbering one-for-one is this program''s largest over-customization risk.Batch characteristic copying and re-derivation on split and merge, including enhancement programs that update collected data each time a shop-floor control number is split.Cavity-level and sub-lot data: carrying mold, machine and cavity identity onto batch characteristics and onto planned/production orders via custom fields, and surfacing it on travelers, labels and packing documents.Traceability reporting: building forward/backward genealogy queries over batch data with CDS, integrating with the Batch Information Cockpit and Global Batch Traceability rather than rebuilding them.Interfaces that carry batch identity - SFC-to-batch one-to-one mapping with the digital manufacturing layer, vendor batch capture, batch data on delivery documents - and the handling of long (up to 40-digit) lot numbers through splits, an open design decision on this program. Required Qualifications 6+ years SAP technical development with 3+ full-lifecycle implementations, including at least 1 on S/4HANA.Strong ABAP OO and ABAP on HANA: CDS views, AMDP, code pushdown and performance optimization; hands-on RAP and modern extensibility (key-user and developer extensibility, released APIs, BAdIs).Demonstrable clean-core delivery: extensions that survive upgrades, and the discipline to refuse core modifications.SAPUI5 / Fiori development including Fiori Elements, annotations, custom controls and launchpad configuration.Hands-on SAP BTP including Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management) and event-based integration; Cloud Foundry or Kyma application development is an advantage.SAP integration technologies: OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc, ALE/EDI, the Data Replication Framework and file-based interfaces; forms and print output (Adobe Forms or SmartForms) for travelers, labels and packing documents.Development against PP, QM and MM/IM/WM with a working functional understanding of what those modules do. description:
Position Summary... The Systems Administrator - Technology Operations is responsible for supporting day-to-day control room operations, including batch processing, system monitoring, and incident management within a mainframe environment. This role ensures system stability, supports critical business processes, and escalates issues appropriately to maintain SLA compliance. The associate works closely with senior team members and SMEs to troubleshoot issues, execute operational procedures, and provide timely support to internal customers. What youll do... About the team 
Our team is dedicated to driving innovation and operational excellence within Walmart Global Tech. Associates on shift are responsible for ensuring that our critical batch flows run successfully and are completed before their Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Team members monitor over 250,000 jobs daily, working collaboratively to ensure all restarts and validations are performed with 100% accuracy prior to any restart. Additionally, associates maintain the stability and health of mainframe systems, implementing maintenance and upgrades as needed. ServiceNow is utilized for incident logging and tracking, supporting efficient resolution and documentation of operational issues 
 What You ll Do Perform daily control room operations, including monitoring alerts, handling batch job abends, and managing incidents in accordance with SOPs. Execute Control-M activities such as holding, releasing, and restarting jobs. Monitor batch flows and escalate issues to ensure SLAs for critical processes are met. Monitor z/OS systems , review logs, and perform initial troubleshooting; engage next-level support when required. Execute operational procedures including IPLs (Initial Program Loads) , maintenance implementations, and task restarts (bounce activities). Monitor system health using tools such as Chronos and report issues to senior leads or SMEs as needed. Create, update, and manage incident tickets and RITMs in ServiceNow , ensuring all tickets are accurately updated before shift end. Provide support to data centers (DCs) , including troubleshooting batch processing issues and resolving printer-related problems. Support and facilitate EDIM (Data Center Power Outage activities) and related operational events. Handle customer support requests via phone queue, email, and chat platforms (Zoom, Teams, Slack) while meeting response SLAs. Follow established escalation procedures and SOPs for issue management and resolution. Maintain proper documentation and communicate issues effectively during shift handovers. What You ll bring 1-3 years of experience in technology operations, control room, or system administration . Basic knowledge of mainframe environments (z/OS) and batch processing concepts. Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Chronos . Experience using collaboration tools like Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Slack . description:

This role provides both technical and people leadership across process simulation, robotics validation, virtual commissioning, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. The position works closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Controls Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing IT, suppliers, and plant operations teams to identify manufacturing risks early, optimize manufacturing processes, and improve production readiness prior to equipment installation and production launch. The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing digital manufacturing capabilities, improving engineering efficiency, and establishing simulation and virtual commissioning standards across multiple automotive manufacturing programs and facilities. Team Leadership Capability Development Build, lead, and develop a Body Process Simulation team supporting BIW manufacturing engineering activities. Define team structure, technical responsibilities, engineering standards, work processes, deliverables, and performance expectations. Lead, mentor, and coordinate a multidisciplinary team of engineers, simulation specialists, controls engineers, contractors, and supplier resources. Recruit, develop, and retain technical talent in process simulation, robotics, offline programming, virtual commissioning, automation, and digital manufacturing technologies. Establish competency frameworks, mentoring programs, training plans, and career development pathways. Manage resource planning, project workloads, budgets, supplier support, and delivery performance across multiple manufacturing programs and locations. Foster a culture focused on safety, collaboration, innovation, quality, continuous improvement, and standardization. Process Simulation Digital Manufacturing Lead the application of Siemens Process Simulate, Tecnomatix, or similar digital manufacturing tools to validate body shop manufacturing processes prior to equipment installation. Establish standard methodologies for: Robot reach and accessibility studies Collision detection and avoidance Cycle time validation Tooling and weld gun accessibility validation Ergonomic assessments Robot path optimization Station layout verification Ensure simulation activities support manufacturing feasibility reviews, equipment design validation, tooling development, and process planning. Develop and maintain simulation models, robot libraries, tooling standards, process libraries, work instructions, and best practices. Improve simulation quality, model accuracy, data management practices, and process validation efficiency. Identify and communicate manufacturing risks, design concerns, capacity constraints, automation challenges, and process issues early during program development. Virtual Commissioning Develop organizational capability in virtual commissioning technologies and methodologies. Lead validation of robot sequences, programmable logic controller (PLC) logic, safety interlocks, equipment interfaces, and automated manufacturing processes in a virtual environment. Define virtual commissioning standards, test procedures, acceptance criteria, and deployment methodologies. Collaborate with Controls Engineering, equipment suppliers, and plant teams to ensure an effective transition from virtual to physical commissioning. Support issue resolution related to robotics, controls, automation systems, simulation models, commissioning activities, and production support. Automation Digital Transformation Drive automation and digital manufacturing initiatives to improve simulation efficiency, engineering productivity, and manufacturing validation processes. Identify opportunities to automate model creation, reporting, data validation, engineering analysis, and repetitive simulation activities. Support the adoption of advanced digital tools, data analytics, digital twins, and AI-enabled engineering solutions to improve engineering productivity, manufacturing risk identification, root-cause analysis, knowledge management, and decision support. Partner with Manufacturing IT, Controls Engineering, Product Development, and Data Analytics teams to evaluate and implement scalable digital manufacturing solutions. Required Qualifications Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Minimum 7+ years of experience in automotive Body-in-White manufacturing, process engineering, manufacturing launches, equipment installation, commissioning, production trials, and ramp-up activities. Minimum 3+ years of experience in digital manufacturing, process simulation, robotics validation. Minimum 3+ years of experience in Virtual commissioning. Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams and coordinating supplier and contractor resources. Hands-on experience with Siemens Process Simulate, Tecnomatix, or equivalent manufacturing simulation platforms. Strong knowledge of body shop robotics, tooling, fixtures, automated manufacturing cells, and material handling systems. Working knowledge of industrial controls, PLC architecture, automation sequencing, robot-controls integration, and virtual commissioning principles. Knowledge of BIW joining technologies, including resistance spot welding, arc welding, laser welding, adhesive bonding, riveting, clinching, or related manufacturing processes. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting multiple automotive OEM manufacturing environments. Advanced experience in offline robot programming and virtual commissioning. Exposure to AI-enabled engineering tools, digital twin technologies, or manufacturing analytics solutions. Knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GDT), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Control Plans, and structured problem-solving methodologies. title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About Metayb Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital-first era. We have grown into a close-knit family of 500+ employees , each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital-first ecosystem of value creation. Our key areas of expertise lie in Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance, and Supply Chain Services . We strongly aspire to venture into IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality . Metayb endeavours to be best-in-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager to manage and coordinate end-to-end logistics, shipment planning, transportation, dispatch, and supply chain operations across the Middle East and Africa region, with a particular focus on Saudi Arabia and Egypt . The role will focus on ensuring smooth shipment execution, timely deliveries, transportation management, supply chain visibility, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The position will work closely with the Head of Logistics to provide operational support, maintain critical logistics information, monitor shipment progress, and proactively manage delivery risks and operational challenges. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, and supply chain operations , along with strong SAP knowledge and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across international markets. This role is based in Chennai and operates on a 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST shift. The working week is Saturday to Thursday , with Friday as the weekly off . Key Responsibilities Shipment Planning & Coordination Coordinate daily dispatch and shipment activities based on customer orders and delivery schedules. Plan and arrange transportation for shipments from factories to customer locations across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other relevant Middle East and African markets . Work closely with the Head of Logistics to support day-to-day logistics planning, execution, and operational decision-making. Act as an operational support and coordination point for the Head of Logistics , maintaining critical shipment, transportation, and logistics information. Ensure timely availability of vehicles, transportation resources, and logistics partners required for shipment execution. Maintain updated contact details and records of transport vendors, drivers, logistics partners, and other relevant stakeholders . Track shipments from dispatch through delivery and proactively identify, report, and resolve potential delays, disruptions, and delivery risks . Coordinate closely with warehouse teams to ensure packing, loading, documentation, and dispatch readiness . Maintain effective communication with internal teams and multi-national stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of logistics operations. Maintain strong governance and visibility across the end-to-end supply chain and logistics process . Develop a strong understanding of business operations and ensure timely fulfilment of customer and business commitments. Transportation & Logistics Management Manage and coordinate transportation activities across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other Middle East and African markets . Liaise with transport vendors, third-party logistics providers, drivers, warehouses, factories, and destination teams to ensure smooth shipment execution. Monitor vehicle movement, shipment status, delivery schedules, and transportation performance. Proactively identify transportation risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions to minimise delivery disruptions. Resolve transportation delays, vehicle availability issues, and delivery-related challenges in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Ensure effective coordination between factories, warehouses, transporters, drivers, customers, and destination teams . Support effective management of freight, transportation resources, shipment tracking, and delivery performance . Maintain accurate records of transportation activities, shipment status, delays, and operational issues. Identify opportunities to improve transportation efficiency, service levels, and supply chain performance . Supply Chain Operations & SAP Leverage strong SAP knowledge to support logistics planning, shipment execution, reporting, and day-to-day supply chain operations. Ensure timely and accurate updates of shipment and logistics information within relevant systems. Monitor supply chain activities and maintain visibility across the order, dispatch, transportation, and delivery cycle . Prepare and maintain logistics and supply chain reports covering shipment status, delivery performance, delays, transportation activities, and operational risks . Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate flow of information across the supply chain. Identify operational bottlenecks and support initiatives focused on process improvement, supply chain efficiency, and operational governance . Ensure adherence to established processes, controls, and governance requirements across logistics operations. Stakeholder & Vendor Management Maintain strong relationships with transport vendors, logistics partners, warehouse teams, factory teams, customers, and internal stakeholders . Coordinate effectively with stakeholders across different countries, cultures, and time zones. Serve as a key coordination point between the Head of Logistics and operational stakeholders . Ensure timely communication of shipment status, operational challenges, delays, and critical escalations. Escalate significant logistics and supply chain issues to the appropriate stakeholders with relevant information and recommended actions. Support effective stakeholder communication to ensure continuity and smooth execution of logistics operations. Build and maintain strong relationships with logistics partners to support reliable transportation and service delivery. Qualifications Bachelors Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline . 15-20 years of experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, or supply chain operations. Strong experience working in manufacturing, factory, warehouse, distribution, or FMCG environments . Extensive experience in shipment planning, transportation coordination, logistics operations, and supply chain management . Experience managing logistics operations across international or multinational markets is preferred. Candidates with strong exposure to Middle East and Africa logistics operations will be preferred. Arabic-speaking candidates will be given priority. Required Skills Strong understanding of transportation, logistics, distribution, and end-to-end supply chain processes . Strong hands-on experience with SAP and proficiency in Microsoft Excel . Experience in logistics reporting, shipment tracking, freight management, and transportation coordination . Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, delivery management, warehouse coordination, and transportation operations . Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and relationship management skills. Strong customer-service orientation with the ability to manage internal and external relationships effectively. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities . High attention to detail with a strong focus on process governance, operational control, and supply chain visibility . Ability to manage multiple priorities and operational challenges in a fast-paced, international environment . Strong ownership and accountability for shipment execution, delivery commitments, and logistics performance . Ability to work effectively with multi-national teams and stakeholders across different regions and time zones . Strong understanding of freight management and shipment tracking systems . Arabic language proficiency will be a significant advantage. Preferred Experience Experience in the FMCG industry . Exposure to logistics and supply chain operations across the Middle East and Africa region . Experience managing shipments to Saudi Arabia, Egypt, GCC countries, or African markets . Experience working with international transportation vendors and logistics partners . Strong exposure to SAP-based supply chain and logistics operations . Arabic language proficiency . Experience supporting or working closely with a Head of Logistics, Supply Chain Director, or senior supply chain leadership .

Key Responsibilities 
 Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

Prepare short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts , analyze variances and drive corrective actions. Develop integrated cash flow models covering O2C, P2P, Capex, debtor commitments and working capital . Manage surplus fund deployment, intercompany funding and cross-border fund transfers. Support global cash pooling, funding requirements and liquidity reporting.

Manage banking documentation, KYC and regulatory compliance . Handle credit facilities, bank guarantees, Letters of Credit (LC), factoring and other banking instruments . Liaise with banks for forex deals, rate negotiation and settlement . 
 Forex & Hedging 
 Manage foreign exchange exposure arising from client billing, vendor payments and intercompany transactions. Design and execute Forex Hedging strategies , including forward contracts and other hedging instruments. Monitor forex rates, currency movements and market trends. Partner with business and finance teams on forex exposure, hedging decisions and risk management . Ensure forex and hedging transactions comply with applicable regulatory requirements. 
 Receivables & Working Capital

Identify significant overdue exposures and potential cash-flow risks. Coordinate with global AR and finance teams on cross-border invoicing and collection issues having forex or funding implications. 
 Compliance, Controls & Reporting 
 Ensure Treasury operations comply with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. Prepare monthly/quarterly Treasury reports covering cash position, forex exposure and banking activities. Support internal and statutory audits related to Treasury, banking and forex. Develop and improve Treasury policies, SOPs, controls and processes . Support Treasury transformation, systems implementation and process standardization initiatives.

Strong experience in Global Treasury Operations within IT Services, Consulting or another global organization. Proven expertise in Cash Flow Management, Liquidity Planning and Working Capital Management . Strong hands-on experience in Forex Management, Forex Hedging and currency risk management . Experience in Bank Reconciliation, banking operations and global bank relationship management . Strong exposure to US client / US business environment and international transactions . Experience managing banking facilities, KYC, guarantees, LC, factoring and treasury documentation . Experience working with multi-currency and multi-entity global organizations . Candidates currently operating at Manager / Senior Manager / Director-level Treasury responsibilities will be considered for the leadership scope. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical and negotiation skills . CA / MBA Finance / CFA / CTP or equivalent professional qualification preferred.

title: Field Inspector
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a PnM Servicing professional responsible for ensuring smooth field operations, effective vendor coordination, and adherence to NoBroker SOPs and service standards. 
 This is a field-intensive role involving daily travel of approximately 30–40 km, regular vendor interactions, and field audits to ensure processes and quality standards are being followed. 
 Key Responsibilities Conduct daily field visits for servicing, operational checks, and audits. Travel approximately 30–40 km daily as part of field operations. Conduct regular field audits to ensure that NoBroker SOPs, processes, and service standards are strictly followed. Identify process deviations, service gaps, and operational issues during field audits. Coordinate closely with vendors to ensure timely and quality execution of services. Monitor vendor performance and adherence to defined SOPs and operational guidelines. Conduct surprise/regular checks at vendor and service locations. Identify gaps and take corrective action in coordination with vendors and internal teams. Maintain proper audit records, observations, and action points. Follow up with vendors to ensure closure of audit findings within timelines. Escalate recurring or critical SOP violations to the relevant teams. Ensure consistent service quality and a positive customer experience. Prepare regular reports on field audits, vendor performance, SOP compliance, and service issues. Required Skills & Qualifications Prior experience working with vendors is preferred/required. Prior experience in Logistics is highly preferred. Experience in field operations, audits, servicing, or vendor management will be an advantage. Comfortable with daily field travel of 30–40 km. Strong understanding of process compliance and operational discipline. Good communication and vendor-management skills. Strong observation and problem-solving abilities. Good follow-up and escalation skills. Ability to identify process gaps and ensure corrective actions. Should be proactive, disciplined, and comfortable working independently in the field. Ideal Candidate 
 The ideal candidate should be field-oriented, process-driven, and strong in vendor management. They should be comfortable conducting audits, identifying operational gaps, and ensuring 100% adherence to NoBroker SOPs across field operations.

Role & responsibilities 
 Job description About Branch Banking: The branches act as the face of Axis Bank for millions of retail customers and is, hence, an integral part of the Banks strategy. Branches play a major role in deposit mobilization from New-To-Bank (NTB) customers, and are also core drivers of the Banks customer engagement strategy across products and services About the Role: As a part of the branch banking team, Branch Relationship Officers (BROs) are responsible for providing financial solutions to customer by offering bank’s products, providing service to existing and New-To-bank customers in the branch and adding new customers through referral generation activities and customer visits. They will be required to use their communication skills to add new customers and Cross Sell of Bank products. As part of daily cadence, BROs are required to engage with existing customers of Bank which are mapped to their portfolio for offering additional products of the bank as per the need of the customer. BROs are expected to process customer transactions and Service requests within defined turnaround time (TAT) and ensure end to end closure. BROs may also be posted as teller as per organization’s requirements for processing cash transactions of customers. BROs shall introduce customers to alternate channels of banking such as Internet Banking, mobile banking, WhatsApp banking wherever possible Key Responsibilities Offering solutions and Cross selling Bank’s retail banking and third party products as per assigned budgets. (Eg. Life insurance, General insurance, Mutual Funds, Loans etc.) Achieve Business budgets as assigned by the organization on a monthly basis consistently. Generating referrals and leads of new customers for sale of bank’s products. Promoting bank’s products by taking part in marketing activities and customer visits outside the branch. Contact existing customers for bringing in more deposits and cross selling of bank’s products. Timely and accurate processing of customer transactions and requests. Handle customer queries and provide correct solutions to ensure there are no customer complaints. Follow all compliance guidelines (regulatory and legislative) for each activity released from time to time. Ensure that all audit requirements of the bank are met optimum audit rating. Complete all mandatory certifications required for the role (EUIN, SP Certification etc.) Complete all learning activities/ trainings conducted by the bank from time to time. Daily entry of interaction with customers in bank’s CRM system. Participate and follow all initiatives/ Campaigns/ Drives that are undertaken by the bank from time to time Qualifications: Optimal qualification for success on the job is: Graduation/ Post-Graduation from a recognized institute Role Proficiencies: For successful execution of the job, the candidate should possess the following: Knowledge of banking regulations and norms Maintain a high level of knowledge of banking products and services Good communication (both verbal and written) skill in both English and the local language Ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines Good networking and relationship building skills

title: Channel Partner Manager
description:
About the Company BPL Medical Technologies is a leading Indian medical technology company committed to advancing healthcare through innovative, reliable, and accessible solutions. With a strong legacy and nationwide presence, BPL serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers across India and select international markets. The company offers a diverse portfolio across patient monitoring, imaging, and critical care, supported by robust manufacturing, service, and distribution capabilities. With a growing installed base and a focus on quality and customer trust, BPL continues to strengthen its position as a trusted partner in healthcare delivery. Driven by innovation and operational excellence, BPL is focused on building future-ready capabilities and delivering long-term value to customers, partners, and stakeholders. Get to know about us - https://www.bplmedicaltechnologies.com/ Role Summary A Channel Partner Manager is responsible for dealer engagement across the market. You'll establish and maintain relationships with dealers/channel partners to promote BPL's business, provide guidance, training, and support to dealers on our products, track dealer metrics and performance, and resolve dealer grievances and issues while ensuring new and existing dealers meet company guidelines on manpower, infrastructure, credit limits, and adherence to company policies and processes. Key Responsibilities Dealer Relationship Management & Business Development Drive business plan and sales strategy for the market to ensure attainment of company sales goals. Build and maintain strong relationships with the dealer base, interfacing directly with all dealer personnel. Provide timely support to help dealers win opportunities. Research and identify potential open markets and drive dealers to perform across their given area. Coordinate with internal team members on support required by dealers. Manage market study analysis to determine optimum dealer count and preferred locations; review and recommend markets, prospects, and product range for expanding dealer operations. Coordinate with Sales Field Operations on dealer improvement and/or replacement of poor-performing dealers. Training & Compliance Train and consult all dealer personnel to ensure a thorough understanding of products, policies, and procedures. Ensure company policies, procedures, and business ethics codes are communicated and implemented within the dealer network. Performance Management & Reporting Manage dealer performance in coordination with Sales Field Operations, including performance assessment, monitoring, and reporting. Provide regular updates on target vs. achievement, segment performance, and budget achievement; coordinate market intelligence and data input. Make regular presentations to management on dealer performance, flagging issues as needed. Documentation & Onboarding Manage CRM support and ISO-relevant process documentation for dealership management. Handle Letters of Intent, Dealer Agreements, and dealer onboarding for new dealers and renewals. What We’re Looking For Qualifications & Experience Technical/Science UG + PG (MBA). 7-10 years of relevant experience with dealer management exposure. Skills & Competencies Strong sales background and dealer operations experience. Excellent communication skills, written and verbal. Experience training personnel. Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills. Ability to work independently, with sound, independent judgement. Strong sales ability to expand footprint in the market by onboarding new dealers. Knowledge of the local markets. Willingness to travel extensively. Why This Role Matters You'll be at the front line of BPL's channel business — shaping how a leading medical technology company reaches customers across Diagnostic Cardiology, Imaging, and Critical Care, gaining: Direct ownership of dealer relationships and performance across your market. The opportunity to build and expand BPL's channel footprint by identifying and onboarding new dealers. Broad exposure to sales strategy, training, compliance, and dealer operations in a single role. The chance to work in a company with real purpose — where stronger dealer partnerships translate directly into wider access to healthcare, aligned to our purpose of Help Save Lives. Location – Bangalore/ Hyderabad/ Chennai

title: Business Intelligence Associate
description:
Position Summary: 
Join athenahealths Marketing BI team as a Business Intelligence Associate - a highly technical and impactful role focused on building, scaling, and maintaining trusted marketing performance insights. In this role, you will be responsible for hands-on data manipulation, advanced SQL querying, and high-performance Power BI dashboard development, turning complex commercial and campaign data into actionable insights for our Marketing department. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical professional who possesses strong data management and visualization capabilities to clean, transform, and analyse large-scale marketing campaign and performance data. About the Team: The Marketing Operations team enables data-driven decision making across athenahealths Marketing organization by developing scalable analytics, reporting, and performance frameworks. The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales, Finance, IT, and Data Engineering to align on go-to-market performance, pipeline measurement, and reporting standards. They manage a broad analytics ecosystem spanning CRM, marketing automation, and enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake and Power BI. The teams mission is to improve the quality, consistency, and accessibility of insights that drive business growth. Essential Job Responsibilities: Power BI Development & Visualization: Build, publish, and maintain business-critical Power BI dashboards. Design efficient star-schema data models, establish seamless relationship mappings, and write advanced DAX calculations (using filter context manipulation, time intelligence, and dynamic security rules). SQL Data Preparation & Processing: Write, debug, and optimize complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, analytical window functions, and multi-table joins) to extract, aggregate, and model raw marketing data from platforms like Snowflake. Advanced Data Handling & Auditing: Manipulate and clean massive, complex datasets from Salesforce CRM and marketing platforms. Act as a gatekeeper of data quality by utilizing advanced Excel techniques (Power Query, nested lookups, dynamic arrays) to validate, reconcile, and audit spreadsheet metrics against final dashboards. KPI Standardization: Implement and maintain standardized marketing KPI definitions and reporting logic across dashboards to ensure consistent "single source of truth" metrics. Legacy Dashboard Rationalization: Reverse-engineer, simplify, and document legacy spreadsheets and Power BI reports to eliminate redundant reporting and improve performance. Stakeholder Collaboration: Translate marketing business questions into exact technical reporting requirements, presenting data insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Additional Job Responsibilities Support ad hoc marketing analysis and custom reporting requests across campaigns, segments, and channels. Collaborate with broader data and IT teams to validate data flows and ensure business reporting accuracy. Promote best practices in query performance, data modelling, and clean visual design within the immediate team. Perform thorough QA and data validation testing on all developed dashboards prior to executive rollouts. Required Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field. 5 years of overall experience and 3+ years of Data analytics, Data Visualization and hands-on Data Manipulation using SQL and Excel. Advanced SQL expertise, including writing and optimizing queries to gather and process large-scale datasets from Snowflake or similar cloud databases. Hands-on experience with data manipulation, lookup functions (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP), and data validation tools to handle large volumes of reporting data. Proven experience designing and building user-friendly Power BI reports, including DAX query creation, data modeling, and performance optimization. Preferred: Basic proficiency in Python for data analysis and task automation, combined with a core understanding of data engineering practices to align with technical partners. Working experience interacting, engaging, and transforming Salesforce CRM data objects such as Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities. Prior experience in US Healthcare or B2B commercial marketing/sales organizations. Familiarity with marketing funnel metrics across prospect lifecycle journey Familiarity with marketing automation tools and standard campaign performance metrics. About athenahealth Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. Our company culture: Our talented employees or athenistas, as we call ourselves spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support. Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That''s one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve. What we can do for you: Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative workspaces some offices even welcome dogs. We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation. In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued. Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP Senior Basis Consultant to manage and support SAP landscapes, with strong hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA Database, system administration, upgrades, migrations, monitoring, performance tuning, and production support . Configure and manage Transport Management System (TMS) and coordinate transport movements across landscapes. Monitor SAP systems, background jobs, work processes, dumps, locks, RFCs, interfaces and system logs; proactively resolve issues. Perform SAP performance analysis, capacity planning and tuning at SAP, HANA/DB and OS levels. Manage High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) activities, including DR testing and recovery procedures. Handle SAP incidents, service requests, problem management and root-cause analysis in an ITIL/AMS environment. Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems. Hands-on experience with HANA installation, upgrades, backup/recovery and system replication . Strong understanding of SAP architecture, system monitoring and performance tuning. Experience with TMS, system refresh, client administration, SAP Notes and OSS support . Knowledge of SAP Fiori/Gateway, Web Dispatcher and SAP security is preferred. Experience with HA/DR, disaster recovery planning and technical troubleshooting . Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical production issues. Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 Preferred 
 SAP Certified Technology Associate / SAP HANA certification. Experience with SAP Cloud / Azure / AWS environments. Experience with SAP Solution Manager or SAP Cloud ALM. Experience in AMS/support environments with SLA-based delivery. Willingness to participate in on-call / weekend activities during critical deployments or production incidents .

title: Senior Manager - Compute Infrastructure and Cloud Ops
description:
Job Summary 
 The Senior Manager, Compute Infrastructure and Cloud Operations, is a strategic leadership role responsible for the reliable, secure, and cost-effective delivery of enterprise compute services across on-premises and cloud environments. The position will lead Windows Server administration, Linux server administration, NetApp storage, VMware virtualization, and cloud operations across AWS and Microsoft Azure. The role requires strong infrastructure delivery experience, forward-looking strategic thinking, mature people leadership, and the ability to operate across multiple business domains while balancing operational stability, modernization, security, risk, and ficial accountability. Responsibilities 
 Provide overall leadership and accountability for enterprise compute infrastructure and cloud operations across on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud environments. Define and execute the compute infrastructure strategy, operating model, technology roadmap, lifecycle plan, and modernization priorities in alignment with business and enterprise technology objectives. Lead service delivery for Microsoft Windows Server platforms, including administration, patching, hardening, capacity management, performance optimization, high availability, and lifecycle management. Lead service delivery for enterprise Linux platforms, including administration, patching, security hardening, performance optimization, configuration management, and platform standardization. Oversee NetApp storage services, including capacity planning, performance, availability, data protection, replication, backup integration, lifecycle management, and storage optimization. Oversee VMware virtualization services, including platform availability, cluster and capacity management, upgrades, security, performance, resilience, and technology lifecycle planning. Provide operational leadership for AWS and Microsoft Azure services, covering goverce, reliability, security, cost optimization, monitoring, incident response, backup, disaster recovery, and operational readiness. Drive hybrid-cloud adoption by identifying appropriate workload placement, migration opportunities, platform standards, automation requirements, and operating controls. Ensure infrastructure services meet agreed availability, performance, security, recovery, compliance, and service-level expectations. Own major incident readiness and response for the compute tower, including technical escalation, stakeholder communication, problem management, root-cause analysis, and prevention of recurring issues. Establish proactive monitoring, observability, event management, capacity forecasting, and operational health reporting across compute, storage, virtualization, and cloud platforms. Drive automation and infrastructure-as-code practices to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, accelerate provisioning, strengthen compliance, and increase operational efficiency. Develop and maintain standards, policies, procedures, service documentation, architecture guardrails, runbooks, and configuration baselines for the compute portfolio. Partner with architecture, cybersecurity, network, database, application, service management, engineering, and business teams to deliver secure and resilient infrastructure solutions. Lead platform upgrades, technical debt reduction, end-of-life remediation, vulnerability treatment, patch compliance, and infrastructure refresh programs. Manage ficial planning for the compute portfolio, including budgets, forecasts, licensing, consumption, hardware and cloud costs, unit-cost transparency, and optimization opportunities. Manage strategic suppliers, technology partners, managed service providers, contracts, service reviews, licensing positions, and vendor performance. Build, lead, coach, and retain a high-performing multi-skilled infrastructure team, with clear accountability, succession planning, career development, cross-training, and continuous capability improvement. Establish measurable operational KPIs and goverce routines covering service reliability, incidents, changes, capacity, vulnerabilities, patching, automation, cost, customer experience, and delivery outcomes. Communicate strategy, risks, service performance, investment needs, and transformation progress effectively to senior technology and business stakeholders. Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, customer focus, disciplined execution, innovation, and continuous improvement across geographically distributed teams. 

 Experience Required 
 At least 18 years of progressive experience in infrastructure delivery and operations, with significant leadership responsibility in large, complex enterprise environments. Demonstrated experience leading compute infrastructure services across multiple business domains and geographically distributed teams. Strong hands-on foundation and leadership experience in on-premises Microsoft Windows Server administration and enterprise Linux server administration. Strong experience managing NetApp storage platforms and VMware virtualization environments at enterprise scale. Proven experience leading cloud operations in AWS and Microsoft Azure, including governance, reliability, security, cost management, and operational support. Experience developing infrastructure strategy, multi-year roadmaps, operating models, transformation plans, business cases, and investment priorities. Proven people-management capability, including organization design, workforce planning, performance enablement, coaching, succession planning, and skills development. Experience managing major incidents, service continuity, disaster recovery, operational risk, audit requirements, security remediation, and regulatory or compliance obligations. Experience driving automation, standardization, observability, self-service, and continuous improvement across infrastructure operations. Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, contracts, licenses, cloud consumption, and operational cost optimization. Strong understanding of IT service management practices, including incident, problem, change, configuration, capacity, availability, and service-level management. Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, decision-making, negotiation, and cross-functional leadership skills. Ability to translate business priorities into practical infrastructure strategies and measurable operational outcomes. Bachelors degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. Relevant professional certifications in IT service management, VMware, NetApp, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Windows, Linux, or enterprise architecture are advantageous.

Role Overview We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic & Presentation Design Intern to support marketing graphics, social media, event collateral, PowerPoint presentations, leadership decks, and internal communications. The intern will translate briefs and complex information into clear, engaging, brand-aligned visual communication while using AI-assisted workflows to improve ideation, productivity, and creative quality. Key Responsibilities Design social media, marketing campaign, digital, and event assets, including posts, banners, posters, standees, backdrops, digital screens, invitations, and signage. Create and enhance PowerPoint presentations for Marketing, Sales, Leadership, and other teams, including pitch decks, proposals, reports, and reusable templates. Create internal communication assets and adapt approved designs across digital, print, and presentation formats. Maintain brand consistency and quality across typography, layout, imagery, alignment, spacing, and final production files. Collaborate with the Creative Director and stakeholders to understand objectives, incorporate feedback, and deliver requirements on time. Good understanding of typography, layout, composition, grids, color theory, visual hierarchy, and information design. Ability to create charts, diagrams, infographics, business visuals, social creatives, and professional presentation layouts. Familiarity with social media formats, corporate presentation design, internal communications, and basic print production. Familiarity with AI-assisted creative and presentation tools and prompt-based workflows is an advantage. A relevant portfolio is preferred; a degree or certification in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field is preferred. **Job Summary**
 Sr Product Architect ISG will define and optimize advanced Generative AI and Machine Learning driven product architectures and validation strategies for life sciences research and development solutions ensuring robust verification and validation outcomes in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on scalable design quality excellence and measurable value for customers and society.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Architect end to end product solutions that integrate Generative AI and Machine Learning capabilities into life sciences research and development platforms to deliver reliable data driven insights for global customers.
* Define scalable technical architectures that align with ISG product strategy by harmonizing analytics pipelines validation frameworks and deployment approaches for complex scientific workflows.
* Lead design of model lifecycle processes including data ingestion feature engineering training evaluation and monitoring to ensure consistent performance and traceability of advanced AI solutions.
* Drive creation of robust validation test execution strategies that cover functional performance usability and compliance aspects for AI enhanced products in regulated life sciences environments.
* Collaborate closely with cross functional teams including data science software engineering product management and quality to translate scientific requirements into clear system and component architecture specifications.
* Provide guidance on verification and validation methods tailored to Machine Learning models including test design scenario coverage model robustness assessment and continuous quality monitoring.
* Optimize architecture for hybrid work delivery by defining modular components standardized interfaces and remote friendly collaboration practices that support distributed teams and efficient iteration.
* Evaluate and select appropriate AI and data technologies by assessing scalability interoperability security and long term maintainability to uphold enterprise standards and customer expectations.
* Develop and review detailed architectural documentation including diagrams data flows and validation plans to ensure shared understanding and traceable decision making across the organization.
* Mentor senior technical contributors in applying best practices for Generative AI solution design model validation and verification workflows to raise overall engineering maturity.
* Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI driven automation and intelligent analytics can improve research outcomes reduce manual effort and accelerate innovation for scientific communities.
* Ensure that validation test execution and verification activities align with regulatory expectations and internal quality frameworks for life sciences solutions to protect patient safety and data integrity.
* Champion architecture decisions that enhance societal impact by enabling more accurate experiments faster discovery cycles and trustworthy AI usage in scientific products.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate extensive experience in designing and delivering complex product architectures that incorporate Generative AI and Machine Learning capabilities for enterprise scale solutions.
* Possess strong hands on background in validation test execution including planning test case design coverage analysis and defect management for software and AI components.
* Show deep familiarity with life sciences research and development verification and validation practices including risk based testing traceability and documentation of scientific systems.
* Apply advanced knowledge of data engineering model evaluation techniques and AI performance optimization to ensure stable and efficient operation of analytics workloads.
* Bring proven expertise in collaborating with multidisciplinary teams such as data scientists engineers domain experts and quality professionals to deliver integrated solutions.
* Utilize strong communication and documentation skills to explain complex architectural decisions AI constraints and validation strategies in clear and concise language.
* Exhibit experience working in hybrid environments by using modern collaboration tools and processes that support effective design reviews and distributed implementation.

 Chennai, India

We work together to empower our partners and customers through our AI-powered customer acquisition and engagement platform to help them get more customers and keep them. In this role, you will act as a trusted expert of Vendasta s platform, fostering a customer-first environment, adopting advanced AI support tools, and ensuring that every single customer interaction adds value and strengthens trust.

Drive Efficiency via AI Fluency: Consistently integrate approved AI tools (e.g., suggestion bots, summarizers, and response tools) into your daily workflows to reduce resolution times, maximize accuracy, and maintain a one-touch solve rate of 68% or higher . We invest deeply in your development through continuous learning opportunities, hands-on exposure to emerging technologies, in-house training, education reimbursement, and leadership development programs designed to help you grow as the world evolves. We support this growth with flexibility, wellness benefits, and an environment that trusts you to do your best work - whether that s learning something new, taking on bigger challenges, or building the next chapter of your career.
