description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
 Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation\-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning \& Urban Design, Water, Environment \& Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
   

  

**Welcome to our Buildings division**
 As one of the top 10 building designers in the world, Ramboll provides sustainable design engineering solutions in residential, commercial, office, hospital, stadium, industrial and Infrastructure projects. 4,000 experts across the world specialise in creating more innovative, sustainable and liveable buildings. We place particular emphasis on our liveable buildings concept where we balance the cultural, social and physical values of buildings, to improve the quality of life for building users.
   

  

 We invite you to demonstrate best practice in sustainable design, early\-stage passive analysis, building performance modelling, life cycle assessment and decarbonisation as we look for an enthusiastic and suitably experienced Sustainability Consultant for the Ramboll Engineering Centre located in Gurugram. The role will support concept design, competition projects and multidisciplinary design teams by translating sustainability ambitions into clear, evidence\-based strategies and performance\-led design recommendations.
   

  

**You will join our Sustainability Team**
 Our Sustainability teams have an in\-depth focus on technical delivery and an excellent understanding of client care, focused on Low and Net Zero Carbon building design. You will be an essential part of a close\-knit team working on a wide variety of projects across the UK and internationally. We have a supporting and collaborative culture and enjoy what we do! We are looking for like\-minded and personable colleagues to strengthen the capabilities of our global team and lead our REC team. Career progression is guaranteed for talented candidates.
   

  

 You will be expected to manage your own project work and support multidisciplinary teams during early design stages, including feasibility studies, competitions and concept design. You should have a strong interest in the overall sustainability scope, including passive design, certification, embodied carbon and operational energy, supported by practical energy simulation experience to assist project teams. Proficiency in Rhino and Grasshopper for parametric design support, working knowledge of IES VE for building performance analysis, and the ability to develop clear outputs that inform design decisions will be important for this role.
   

  

 We offer a highly supportive environment in which you can develop and grow in your role. For the right candidate there is the opportunity to progress, with increasing management and mentoring responsibilities as you grow in your role.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Be Educated to Masters/ bachelor’s level in Engineering, Architecture or Built Environment and having gained relevant practical experience in a similar role, you have demonstrable knowledge and experience of building physics, particularly in relation to heat transfer, energy, comfort criteria, ASHRAE Guidance and other industry standards (CIBSE beneficial).
* Have demonstrable knowledge and experience of multiple\-asset project sustainability and building physics, particularly in relation to thermal comfort, passive design, compliance modelling and real operational energy assessments.
* Support early\-stage passive design analysis for concept, feasibility and competition projects, including orientation, massing, shading, façade optimisation, daylight access, thermal comfort and low\-energy design strategies.
* Use Rhino and Grasshopper to support parametric sustainability studies, rapid design optioneering, visualisation of performance outcomes and evidence\-based design inputs for architects and wider project teams.
* Have in depth\-knowledge of dynamic simulation software’s including an understanding of climate\-based daylighting analysis, operational energy calculation and life cycle analysis and life cycle costing is highly desirable.
* Undertake life cycle assessment studies covering embodied and operational carbon, preferably using One Click LCA, and prepare clear carbon reduction recommendations, benchmarking outputs and client\-facing summaries.
* Given the collaborative and client focused nature of this role, effective communication skills and some experience of using your initiative to overcome challenges are essential.
* Proven experience, or a strong interest, in delivering overall sustainability scope across projects, including sustainability strategies, energy strategies, IES VE energy modelling and assessment support.
* Check and quality assure the work of others in all technical aspects of building performance modelling in IES VE
* Be responsible for the day\-to\-day running of projects, workload planning and delivery, and providing technical input as required.
* Produce energy strategies for planning applications, carrying out both Domestic and Non\-Domestic Building Regulations like Part L compliance assessments using IES VE
* Complete thermal comfort assessments to UK technical standards e.g. ASHRAE, CIBSE TM52, CIBSE TM59 and UK Buildings Regulations Part O
* Produce Passive Design and Low and Zero Carbon Reports to meet BREEAM Ene 04 credit requirements.
* Contribute to sustainability certification strategies and documentation for schemes including LEED, WELL, BREEAM, Estidama, Barjeel and Mostadam.
* Carry out Operational Energy assessments using IES VE, industry standards e.g. CIBSE TM54 etc.


**Qualifications**
* A Master’s/Bachelor’s degree qualification in an Mechanical Engineering/Sustainable Architecture/ Building Performance or allied subjects
* 10\+ years’ experience working within the Building Physics / Sustainability sector, preferably within a consulting environment.
* Experience in energy, passive design and parametric modelling, including the use of Rhino and Grasshopper to support early\-stage design analysis and competition submissions.
* Working knowledge of building performance modelling from concept to completion using IES VE or similar tools, including daylight, thermal comfort, operational energy and passive design assessments.
* Technical background in sustainable building design with a forward\-thinking approach to passive design, operational energy, embodied carbon and whole\-life carbon, supported by life cycle assessment experience using One Click LCA or equivalent platforms.
* Experience of sustainability certification schemes such as LEED, WELL, BREEAM, Estidama, Barjeel and Mostadam, including early\-stage credit advice, gap analysis and documentation support.
* Experience in consulting, delivery and implementation of carbon and project sustainability strategies.
* Interest in supporting the broader sustainability scope of projects, with the ability to contribute through energy simulation, design analysis and practical technical inputs.
* Self\-motivated, dedicated, and proactive with a passion for detail.
* Demonstrated excellence in providing high\-quality client service.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to organise and prioritise workflow.
* Ability to generate new work from new and existing clients.


**Your starting point for constant growth**
 From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:
   

  

  

* Being a qualified Engineer having a proven and demonstrable track record in their discipline
* Proven experience in all aspects of building physics, including building energy modelling and compliance analysis using IES or SAP
* Have good knowledge of passive design, LZC technologies, net zero design principles, operational energy, embodied carbon and early\-stage sustainability interventions, and use this knowledge to influence concept and competition\-stage design decisions.
* Demonstrate good attention to detail and show pride in the work produced.
* Have an ability to manage and educate more junior engineers on modelling best practices as well as industry best practices.


**Additional Information**
**What we can offer you**
* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are.
* Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects.
* The long\-term thinking of a foundation\-owned company


**We offer:**
* A challenging and interesting workday characterized by continuous learning, in an environment where you have many to spar with and learn from.
* Opportunity to work with varied work tasks, across the organization.
* Opportunity to develop and influence your own area of responsibility.


**Work at the heart of sustainable change**
 Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realize their full potential.
   

  

**Ready to join us?**
 Are you our new Lead Piping Engineer? If yes, click the apply button and send your application as soon as possible.
   

  

 Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc.
   

  

 Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

In this role, you will act as a trusted expert of Vendasta s platform, fostering a customer-first environment, adopting advanced AI support tools, and ensuring that every single customer interaction adds value and strengthens trust.

Drive Efficiency via AI Fluency: Consistently integrate approved AI tools (e.g., suggestion bots, summarizers, and response tools) into your daily workflows to reduce resolution times, maximize accuracy, and maintain a one-touch solve rate of 68% or higher . You are highly proficient with customer support platforms (such as Zendesk or Intercom) and have an analytical aptitude for triaging tickets based on severity and time sensitivity. You have a proven track record of multitasking and prioritizing in a dynamic, high-volume environment while maintaining a solution-oriented mindset. By combining a businesss unique data with AI and automation, Vendasta simplifies marketing, sales, and operations, eliminating the need for multiple disjointed systems.

We invest deeply in your development through continuous learning opportunities, hands-on exposure to emerging technologies, in-house training, education reimbursement, and leadership development programs designed to help you grow as the world evolves. We support this growth with flexibility, wellness benefits, and an environment that trusts you to do your best work - whether that s learning something new, taking on bigger challenges, or building the next chapter of your career. title: Clinical Investigator
description:
Job Title: Clinical Investigator/Medical Coder Experience: Fresher/Experience(1-3years) Qualification: Any Graduate (BHMS/BAMS/BUMS/BPT/MPT Preferred) Certification: CPC (AAPC Certified) Mandatory Location: Chennai, Noida, Hyderabad Role Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Investigator to investigate, review, and resolve healthcare claims by identifying potential fraud, abuse, billing inaccuracies, and coding discrepancies. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in medical coding, claims investigation, US healthcare, medical records review, and compliance. This role involves conducting clinical investigations, reviewing medical documentation, validating coding accuracy, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and supporting claim resolution activities while maintaining the highest quality and accuracy standards. Key Responsibilities Clinical Investigation Investigate healthcare claims to identify potential fraud, abuse, billing errors, and inappropriate claim submissions. Review medical records, clinical documentation, and claim details to validate coding accuracy and reimbursement eligibility. Analyze medical history and supporting documentation to determine claim validity. Monitor and investigate high-value or complex claims when required. Medical Coding Review Review CPT, ICD, HCPCS, diagnosis, and procedure codes for coding accuracy. Apply coding guidelines and reimbursement policies during claim investigations. Ensure compliance with coding standards and regulatory requirements. Identify coding discrepancies and recommend appropriate resolutions. Claims Investigation & Resolution Investigate, recover, and resolve healthcare claims across commercial and government health plans. Coordinate claim recovery and reimbursement activities where applicable. Support claim adjudication through detailed clinical and coding analysis. Document investigation findings and maintain accurate case records. Compliance & Quality Ensure adherence to healthcare regulations, reimbursement policies, and contractual obligations. Maintain compliance with applicable state and federal healthcare requirements. Follow established quality standards and investigation protocols. Support audit readiness through accurate documentation and reporting. Collaboration & Stakeholder Support Work closely with claims, coding, quality, and clinical teams to resolve investigation cases. Provide guidance on coding-related issues when required. Support reporting, special projects, and continuous improvement initiatives. Coordinate activities and share knowledge with team members as needed. Documentation & Reporting Maintain complete investigation records and supporting documentation. Prepare investigation summaries and case reports. Ensure accurate and timely documentation of investigation outcomes. Track case progress and maintain required productivity and quality metrics. Required Qualifications Education Any Graduate. Preferred qualifications: BHMS BAMS BUMS BPT MPT B.Sc. Nursing or BDS with minimum 1 year of corporate healthcare experience. Certification AAPC Certified Professional Coder (CPC) – Mandatory Only CPC certification will be considered. Experience Minimum 1 year of experience in Medical Coding or Clinical Investigation. Experience in specialty coding such as: Evaluation & Management (E&M) Surgery Anesthesia Multi-specialty coding Experience beyond HCC coding is preferred. Preferred Skills US Healthcare knowledge. Claims processing experience. Health Insurance and Managed Care experience. Medical records review. Clinical documentation analysis. Healthcare reimbursement guidelines. Fraud, Waste & Abuse (FWA) investigations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and quality focus. Key Competencies Clinical Investigation Medical Coding (CPC) CPT, ICD & HCPCS Coding Claims Investigation Claims Processing Medical Record Review US Healthcare Health Insurance Managed Care Compliance & Regulatory Guidelines Fraud, Waste & Abuse (FWA) Reimbursement Policies Quality Assurance Documentation & Reporting Analytical Thinking Problem Solving Attention to Detail Cross-functional Collaboration Required Qualifications: Graduation Any Graduate, BHMS/BAMS/BUMS/BPT/MPT (preferred) B.Sc. Nursing and BDS with 1 year of corporate experience Must be a certified coder through AAPC. Certifications accepted - CPC Only Experience Range - >1 Year (if not medical graduate)- specialty coding such as E&M, surgery, anesthesia etc, but not only HCC Extensive work experience within own function. Proven attention to detail & Quality focused Proven good Analytical & comprehension skills
